title: Register accepted Hive-CI releases and separately authorize staged canaries
intended_behavior: Bahia consumes only signed successful terminal RELEASE kind-5402 results whose tags and content match the grasp-gitea producer contract.

Accepted releases register exactly one artifact by immutable manifest digest with complete signed 5402, trusted 5401, worker admission, policy, SBOM, provenance, rollback, health, and readiness lineage.
CI registration never creates a deployment intent or changes desired state.
A separately signed and RBAC-authorized ContextVM kind-25910 service/deploy mutation using bahia.deploy.v2 may create a staged canary from the registered digest.
Registration and promotion accept/reject decisions produce signed kind-4903 evidence in the durable outbox.

included: Hive-CI release ingestion and replay validation
excluded: live relay, Harbor, or worker integration tests
automatic widening of a successful canary

contract_gap: cascadia-go v1.2.1 has generated generic 5401/5402 kind constants but no generated release-provenance payload/tag binding for the producer-specific terminal RELEASE shape; Bahia centralizes the mirrored adapter contract instead of scattering numeric aliases.
